context: M1 escort leg 3: W 28th to W 31st. The Empire State lights up ahead.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: There she is. Lights come on, she looks rich. Like the rest of us.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: You still park on Thirty-Fifth, Carl?

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Not anymore. Not since… Just walk, kid.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: City's broke. Department's scared. And the money? It didn't go anywhere.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: It's just waiting for somebody to pick it up.
